answer: Use quadratic admission pricing. Track each funding wallet's dune: how many identities it has created. The nth registration pays base fee times n squared, and the cost ripples forward: every new clone raises the price for all later ones from the same wallet. Fees sit in a vesting vault for 90 days, funding liveness audits. Honest agents pay base once; N clones pay roughly base times N cubed over 3, while clone revenue stays linear in N, so fleets turn unprofitable fast.
